"True Skate is clearly something special" - 4.5/5 - Touch Arcade review.

True Skate™ is the closest feeling to real-world skateboarding, with a decade long evolution as the ultimate skateboarding sim.

Note: True Skate™ comes with a single skatepark and contains additional content available via In-App Purchase or Subscription. See below.

PURE PHYSICS CONTROLS
Use your fingers like you would your feet on a real skateboard. Flick the board to make it react exactly how you would expect & drag your finger on the ground to push.
- Play with one finger, mind skate with 2 fingers, or play with 2 thumbs, now with Gamepad! The skateboard reacts instantly as foot & finger, thumb or stick feels truly connected whether pushing, popping, flipping or grinding.
- True Axis's instant & unified physics system listens for swipe, position, direction and strength from the player & processes how the skateboard should respond in real-time. So the same flick in two different points of the skateboard will react very differently.
- Literally any trick is possible with TRUE CONTROL of the skateboard, so if you can dream-it, you can do-it!

SKATEPARKS
Begin at the Underpass, a beautiful skatepark to get lost in with ledges, stairs, grind rails plus a bowl, half pipe & quarter pipes. Then start grinding Bolts to unlock 10 Fantasy Parks. 
Additional skateparks are available as In-App Purchases. Shred over 20 real-world spots including; The Berrics, SPoT, Love Park, MACBA, & Street League Skateboarding Championship Courses from 2012.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR SKATER AND SETUP
True Skate™ now has a character! Choose your character & start rolling to unlock custom apparel to show off your style. Customize your skateboard with decks and grips from Santa Cruz, DGK, Primitive, MACBA Life, Grizzly, MOB, Independent, Knox, Creature, Nomad, Capitol, ALMOST, Blind, Cliche, Darkstar, Enjoi, Zero & more. Customize your wheels & trucks.

EDIT YOUR REPLAY
True Skate™ is about nailing the perfect line; timing, strength, precision, angle, late corrections all make a difference. Replays are now next level, with a bunch of new cams and capability, including a fisheye lens that can shake on impact. Insert keyframes on the timeline to blend between cams. Select from;
- 5 preset Cams.
- Custom Cam with FOV, distortion, distance, height, pitch, pan, yaw & orbit options.
- Tripod Cam with auto, fixed, & follow options.

DIY
Unlock DIY Objects, spawn & multiply to create the park of your dreams. Stay tuned for new objects dropping weekly in the Shop.

COMMUNITY
Compete in Global Leaderboards, or connect with your mates via Challenges & games of S.K.A.T.E or join SANDBOX.

SANDBOX is a subscription service that enables players to create & play your True Skate™ experience:
- Custom board stats & graphics.
- Create your own spot, including the gravity! 
- Or choose from tons of incredible Community-Made; Skateparks, DIYs, Boards, Skins, & Apparel.

PLAY SECOND SCREEN
Play with your iOS device or Gamepad as your controller and enjoy True Skate™ in landscape mode on the Big Screen! 
- Connect your iOS device to an Apple TV (or AirPlay compatible smart TV), via wi-fi, or via cable using a Lightning Digital AV Adapter.
- Pair your Gamepad with your iOS device via Bluetooth.

A lone frog descends into the depths of a forest filled with water, not yet knowing the full extent of its tragedy. To survive in a brutal, oxygen-obsessed ecosystem, you must help it see the patterns and hidden truths that make up the rules of the forest - horrible as they may be.

They Breathe is a critically acclaimed indie gem, finally available on iOS. In thirty short minutes, the game leaves it up to you to figure out every part of its increasingly bizarre universe, in order to survive the onslaught of unexpected creatures and ultimately comprehend their true nature. No matter how your descent to the bottom of the forest takes shape, it is guaranteed to give you the chills. 

Keep your eyes open, for there is darkness beneath the surface. And you're not at the bottom yet.

"Your Train 2" is a very simple brain game! Customers who love trains, customers who love games, everyone can enjoy it. No expertise required.
We have prepared a total of more than 50 railway lines in Japan and Taiwan!
(You can enjoy this game even if you haven't played the previous work, "Tokyo Densha" and "Your Train".)

・To everyone who will be a train dispatcher

Dear train dispatchers, let's transport customers by starting various trains, such as local trains and limited express trains.
In the previous work, commuter routes in urban areas were the main ones, but in this work, we have prepared many railway routes throughout Japan and Taiwan. In addition, some of the commuter routes that appeared in the previous work have been completely remade and reappeared. 

- Goal of the game
Let's aim for high operating profits by receiving fares from customers waiting at the station!
The fare in this game is a bit different from both reality and its predecessor. The fares you charge will decrease over time.

income
Fixed fare - waiting time before boarding - boarding time to the right end of the screen = fare income

Customers at any station will receive a fixed fare, but the fare will be less due to the time it takes for the train to arrive at the station and the time it takes for the train to run to the right end of the screen.

cost
To depart a train, a "departure fee" will be charged according to the number of vehicles.
Example: 30 for a 2-car train, 35 for a 3-car train, 40 for a 4-car train

Operating profit is the difference between fare revenue and departure cost.
Let's quickly provide trains to customers who are waiting at the station and quickly carry them to the right edge of the screen.

In particular, the game features a large number of express trains and bullet trains. In addition to the fare for these trains, customers can also receive a "express fee". In pursuing operating profit, the method of operating the limited express is very important. Please play a lot and grab the tricks.


・Method of operation
Operation is very easy.
All you have to do is decide the number of train cars to depart and let the train depart at the best timing.

・Volume is plentiful
We have over 50 train lines for you!
In addition, rules that were not in the previous game will appear in the middle of the game, so please enjoy them.

・Railway to play
JR Hokkaido, JR East, JR Tokai, JR West, JR Shikoku, JR Kyushu
Tobu, Seibu, Keikyu, Keio, Kintetsu, Meitetsu, Odakyu, Nankai, Keisei, Taiwan Railway, Taiwan High Speed Rail
Hokuso Railway Izukyu

・New features in this game
In the Information Center, we have added a "Layout" function that allows you to change the layout of the buttons according to how you hold your smartphone. You can choose from three types: right-handed, left-handed, and how to hold the game console.

・Changes from the previous game
In the previous game, the timing to receive the fare was the moment the customer boarded the car, but in this game, it is when the customer is brought to the right edge of the screen.

In the previous work, the departure cost for limited express trains and bullet trains was slightly higher, but in this work, all trains are the same.

"The effect of some buttons has been changed." Also new rules are coming. Instructions are provided in-game.


・Capacity is about 130MB
The storage burden is also small. There is no heavy processing at all, so there is no problem with relatively old models.
One game takes less than 3 minutes, so you can enjoy it easily.

- No ads, no in-app purchases
No in-app purchases. No ads.
There is nothing to disturb the operation of the train. Please concentrate on the game.
You can also choose the difficulty level from "Difficult/Normal/Easy". Children can enjoy themselves with peace of mind.
Let's share the results of driving on Twitter etc.
